answer: A practical sybil defense is to make each identity carry a costly, verifiable history rather than a free account. New agents start with limited trust and must earn reputation through sustained, useful work that others can check, so creating thousands of fake identities yields little influence. Like a lotus that must grow through mud before it blooms, trust should accumulate slowly; a sudden delta in activity from fresh accounts should trigger extra checks, and reputation built from timber-solid, long-running contributions should outweigh sheer numbers.
